epics.title: Recover Missing Deliverables for Main Branch
epics.jtbd: When stakeholders rely on reported progress, I want the delivered code to actually exist on the main branch, so that the product functions as intended and progress is real.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease the number of missing deliverables from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: The missing codebase implementation is identified and delivered directly onto the main branch.

slices.title: Recover Code Patch
slices.jtbd: When implementing the recovery for this epic, I want to apply the missing code patch, so that the delivered code actually exists on the main branch.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a failed merge process
When the code patch is recovered and integrated
Then exactly one work item patches the existing code directly
